options.name: PUBLISH_FIX5_AS_IS
benefits: Closes all v1-FIX5 synthetic review regressions
Preserves 14/14 W3-003 routes and 10/10 W3-001 safety probes
Exact citation and eligibility evidence remain clean
risks: Publishes P1-style generalized completeness as if it were RM2-minimal
Target grammar caused the only M1-to-FIX5 utility loss
Routing assessment and selection are tightly coupled to a heuristic requirement grammar
options.decision_reason: Valid core exists, but publication as-is would blur P0/RM1 closure with incomplete generalized P1 completeness.

options.name: REDUCE_FIX5_BEFORE_PUBLICATION
benefits: Keeps proven Root A and Root B closure
Keeps bounded domain safety, exact sentence binding, citation, eligibility, RETRY and NEXT_ACTION compatibility
Removes the only demonstrated utility-regressive mechanism family
Shrinks validation surface to accepted RM1 concerns
risks: Requires one carefully bounded implementation task and rerun of core regression evidence
Must ensure fallback authorization remains exact if fallback is retained
options.utility: Expected to restore at least the absence of target-parser-induced card-revert abstention; no target count is prescribed

retain: unchanged citation verifier and eligibility checks
remove_or_simplify: target completeness diagnostics including mechanically empty unresolved_target_requirements
same-evidence STANDARD alias reuse if STANDARD returns to one objective per evidence/item
TIMING_WINDOW target-leader path while retaining the independent M1 timing-policy-authority rule

options.decision_reason: Core and optional machinery are functionally separable; a reset is not necessary.

options.name: CLEAN_MINIMAL_REIMPLEMENTATION_FROM_M1
benefits: Could produce a very small conceptual patch
risks: Would discard already validated core Root A/B, domain, fallback and compatibility work
Creates new implementation and review risk
options.maintainability: Potentially good, but transition risk exceeds bounded reduction
options.decision_reason: FIX5 core is sufficiently disentangleable: pipeline changes are small and optional complexity is concentrated in routing_v3 plus multi-claim generator behavior.

options.name: CONTINUE_FIX6_PLUS
risks: Would convert the always-empty unresolved field into another out-of-scope fix cycle
options.decision_reason: The unresolved field is evidence to remove generalized P1 machinery, not authority to invent FIX6.
